other_mail_server.title: Other Mail Server
other_mail_server.tip: Enter mail server address and port when selecting other mail server

mail_port.title: Mail Server Port
mail_port.tip: e.g.: smtp.126.com port is 25, smtp.qq.com port is 465 or 587

sender_mail.title: Sender Email
sender_mail.tip: Sender email address, must match mail server

password.title: Password/Authorization Code
password.tip: Password or authorization code of sender email; using authorization code is more secure. Refer to mail provider documentation for how to obtain one

custom_mail_server.title: IMAP Server Address
custom_mail_server.tip: Enter the specified IMAP server address

custom_mail_port.title: IMAP Server Port
custom_mail_port.tip: Enter the specified IMAP server port

user_mail.title: User Mail Account
user_mail.tip: Username for IMAP server authentication, typically the email account. Follow the specific mail provider's requirements

user_password.title: Authorization Code
user_password.tip: Authorization code for IMAP server authentication. Usually requires SMS verification to activate. Some providers use account password. Follow the specific mail provider's requirements

max_return_num.title: Max Email Return Count
max_return_num.tip: Maximum number of emails to return

unseen_flag.title: Unread Emails Only
unseen_flag.tip: Fetch only unread emails or all emails

folder_name.title: Folder Name
folder_name.tip: Enter the mailbox folder name to receive emails from, default is INBOX

mask_as_read_flag.title: Mark as Read
mask_as_read_flag.tip: Mark emails as read after fetching

mail_list.title: Save Email List
mail_list.tip: Specify a variable name to store the returned email list
